spans.s:
The affix मयट् comes after the word व्रीहि in the sense of a पुरोडाश।

Terms: मयट्

The affix ढक् comes in the sense of 'a place of growing, when it is a field' after the words 1. व्रीहि and 2. शालि।

Terms: ढक्

The affixes इनि and ठन् come in the sense of मतुप् after the words व्रीहि etc. as well as the affix मतुप् ।

Terms: इनि and ठन्
